xna-type.name: EffectParameterCollection
xna-type.summary: Manipulates a collection of EffectParameter objects.

property.name: Count
property.summary: Gets the number of EffectParameter objects in this EffectParameterCollection.
property.value: The number of EffectParameter objects in this EffectParameterCollection.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets a specific EffectParameter object by using an index value.
property.value: The EffectParameter object at index index.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets a specific EffectParameter by name.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Returns an enumerator that can iterate through the EffectParameterCollection.

overload.summary: Returns an enumerator that can iterate through the EffectParameterCollection.

method.name: GetParameterBySemantic
method.summary: Gets the handle of a top-level parameter or a structure member parameter by looking up its semantic with a case-insensitive search.

overload.summary: Gets the handle of a top-level parameter or a structure member parameter by looking up its semantic with a case-insensitive search.

parameters.parameter: The name of the semantic to search for.

overload.returns: The first parameter that matches the semantic, or null if no matching parameter was found.
overload.remarks: Getting an effect parameter by semantic is a slow operation. Avoid-high frequency calls.
